notes: Coordinates are fixed and evenly spaced; scalar parameters are rounded to float32. Times are median of three calls after one warm-up, including harness conversion and Metal file I/O, process startup and shader compilation. Judge timing includes tracemalloc overhead. Memory is MiB. Child ru_maxrss is a cumulative high-water mark, so its delta can be zero after warm-up and is not an individual child's peak; the absolute high-water mark is also reported. Process RSS is likewise a lifetime high-water mark. Relative differences use the peak reference magnitude as denominator to avoid singularities at zero crossings.
